clips.title: The story
paras: In southern Darkshore, mature moonstalkers carry the hides Terenthis needs. Their Fine Moonstalker Pelt is thick and healthy enough for an enchanted cloak that helps searchers pass the region’s hostile beasts unnoticed.

Moonstalker sires and matriarchs have coats dense and healthy enough to yield a fine pelt. They hold territories along the Wildbend River and farther south toward Ashenvale’s borders, where they hunt with patience. Common moonstalkers prowl across Darkshore’s forests, but their hides are not fine enough.
